messages:
Maya (marketing): Quick ask for the launch narrative: can runtime run a reproducible bench we can cite showing per-token latency, batch effects, and caching impact? Need a tiny reproducibility bundle for the blog + CSV for internal review.
Priya (eng-runtime): Yep. What does the marketing bundle need to include exactly (metrics + formats)?
Maya (marketing): Headline row for the blog: p50/p90/p99 latencies, avg tokens generated, and an estimated $/1k tokens using current hosted pricing. Also a 1-paragraph methodology blurb, and a curl example we can paste. Appendix can have the full matrix + raw anonymized CSV.
Oliver (runtime): Proposal: models=[redwood-rl-7b, redwood-rl-70b], variants=[fp16, int8-q4], seq_lens=[32,256,512], batch_sizes=[1,16,64]. Headline sample size: 250 samples per cell. Appendix: 1000 samples per cell. Also include two cache modes: cold (no KV) and warmed (10 prefix calls).
Maya (marketing): 250 headline samples sounds good. For the blog we want the 256-length, batch=1 and batch=16 rows called out. Please also run a short concurrency burst (200 concurrent len=32) and a 5min sustained 20 QPS run to show tail behavior.
Zoe (data-ops): For logs we'll scrub prompts and user ids. We'll keep per-request: ts, model, variant, seq_len, batch, latency_ms, tokens_out, gpu_mem_mb, trace_id. We'll deliver a CSV and a condensed JSON summary (metrics only).
Oliver (runtime): Smoke checklist before big runs: 1) single-sample sanity for each model/variant, 2) warmup sequence for KV cache (10 prefixes), 3) small output-diff check between fp16 and int8 (basic token overlap). If smoke OK, we start headline matrix.
Maya (marketing): Timeline: need headline numbers + reproducible curl snippet by Thursday EOD for copy. Appendix runs can finish next Mon. Can you commit to that?
Priya (eng-runtime): Thursday EOD is tight but plausible if we prioritize concurrency limits. We'll push the headline matrix first and background appendix sweep after.
bench-bot: queued run rb-2026-10-05-007 matrix=[models:2 variants:2 seqs:3 batches:3 samples:250 cache_modes:2], estimated_wall_time=4h30m
Oliver (runtime): Example curl for the reproducibility appendix (feel free to shorten for copy):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rl-7b","variant":"int8-q4","input":"Short summary: ...","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.1,"top_p":0.95,"seed":1234}'

Maya (marketing): Perfect. Please include the tiny methodology blurb explaining sample sizes, deterministic seed, anonymization, and that burst p99 includes cold starts. Add :rocket: when done so I can grab the numbers.
Priya (eng-runtime): Will drop the headline CSV and the small reproducible bundle here when finished. Tagging @Zoe for the scrub workflow.
Zoe (data-ops): I'll prepare the scrub script and schema doc. We'll output CSV + metrics.json with the p50/p90/p99 rows.
Maya (marketing): Thanks all 38944d
